```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Start-up fails because the R3 shunts make the core degenerate at low current: with the BJTs off, branch currents are equal at any level. The start-up releases too early (trip ~0.6 V, where the core is still in the weak region) and x is never forced high. Fix: raise the inverter trip to ~0.75 V, use a stronger MS1 pull-down, and add MS4 to kick x high."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "R1":    (250e3, 120e3, 600e3),   # PTAT resistor
    "k3":    (11.5, 7.0, 16.0),       # R3/R1 ratio -> TC trim
    "vref_t":(0.95, 0.90, 1.0),       # target Vref (model calibrated to sim)
    "Lp":    (4.0, 1.0, 10.0),        # PMOS mirror L
    "gmid_p":(14.0, 8.0, 18.0),
    "Ln":    (2.0, 0.5, 6.0),         # NMOS level-shift pair L
    "gmid_n":(22.0, 14.0, 26.0),
    "gmid3": (4.5, 3.0, 10.0),        # MN3 driver
    "Vrs":   (0.25, 0.1, 0.4),        # drop on MN3 source resistor
    "Cx":    (1e-12, 0.3e-12, 4e-12), # dominant-pole cap at x
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    N = 8
    mQ1 = 4
    mQ2 = mQ1 * N
    R1 = p["R1"]
    R3 = p["k3"] * R1
    dVbe = UT * math.log(N)
    Ip = dVbe / R1
    Veb = 0.76 - UT * math.log(10e-6 / (Ip / mQ1))
    Ic = Veb / R3
    I = Ip + Ic
    kcal = 0.9216 / 0.91              # sim/model calibration
    R4 = p["vref_t"] / (I * kcal)
    Rs = p["Vrs"] / I

    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I, vds=0.5)
    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Ln"], I, vds=0.4, vsb=Veb)
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmid3"], 4.0, I, vds=0.4, vsb=p["Vrs"])

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    n.dev("MP1", "x", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("MP2", "nb", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("MP3", "vref", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("MP4", "pg", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("MN2", "nb", "nb", "eb", "vss", mn)
    n.dev("MN1", "x", "nb", "ea", "vss", mn)
    n.dev("MN3", "pg", "x", "s3", "vss", m3)
    n.R("RS", "s3", "vss", Rs)
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "ea", m=mQ1)
    n.R("R1", "eb", "e2", R1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "e2", m=mQ2)
    n.R("R3A", "ea", "vss", R3)
    n.R("R3B", "eb", "vss", R3)
    n.R("R4", "vref", "vss", R4)
    n.C("CX", "x", "vss", p["Cx"])
    # start-up: detector inverter with trip ~0.75 V (pfet W/L ~4x nfet W/L);
    # the core is degenerate at low current (BJTs off, R3 only), so hold
    # start-up until vref is well above that region.
    n.M("MS2", "sx", "vref", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 1.0)
    n.M("MS3", "sx", "vref", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 4.0)
    n.M("MS1", "pg", "sx", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 0.5)    # pull pg low
    n.M("MS4", "vdd", "sx", "x", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 1.0)    # kick x high -> MN3 on

    vref = I * R4 * kcal
    dVeb_dT = (Veb - 1.17 - 3 * UT) / 300.0
    dI_dT = dVeb_dT / R3 + (dVbe / 300.0) / R1
    slope = dI_dT * R4 * kcal
    curv = 0.045                      # empirical curvature (sim TC ~1.37x prev model)
    tc = (abs(slope) * 165 + curv) / vref / 165 * 1e6
    line_reg = vref * (mp.gds / I) * 1.2
    power = 1.8 * (4 * I + 80e-9)     # + start-up inverter subthreshold leak
    psrr = -db(line_reg) if line_reg > 0 else 60
    return n, {"vref": vref, "tc_ppm": tc, "line_reg": line_reg,
               "power": power, "psrr_1k": psrr, "startup_ok": 1}
```
